title: eo queryables --json — a collection's filterable attributes
description: Emitted by `eo queryables <collection> --json` (src/eosdk/cli/commands/queryables.py) as a JSON ARRAY. Each element is Queryable.model_dump(mode="json") (src/eosdk/models.py::Queryable). `name` is backend-native (`eo:cloud_cover` on STAC, `cloudCover` on OData) and is accepted verbatim as a `--filter` key for the same --protocol — that round trip is the whole point of the command (SPEC §6.5). A collection that advertises no queryables makes the command fail with UnsupportedQueryFeature rather than emit `[]`. Hand-written on purpose: it is a contract, not a projection of the model. `additionalProperties` is true on the queryable object — downstream consumers must tolerate fields added later.

name.description: Backend-native attribute name, usable as-is in `--filter name=<value>` for the same protocol.

type.description: Value type, null when the backend declares none. The SDK normalizes to `string | number | integer | boolean | datetime`; the STAC backend passes an unrecognized declared type through verbatim, so this is deliberately not an enum — consumers must treat an unknown name as unknown, not as an error.

raw.description: The untouched backend declaration (a JSON-Schema fragment on STAC, an Attributes entry on OData). Backend-specific by design.
